caption: This shio broth ramen features a clear golden-yellow soup with thin noodles, shredded cabbage, and a red chili garnish. Served in a white ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, it rests on a wooden table with warm brown tones and grain patterns.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The shio (salt) broth is clear golden-yellow, holding thin noodles, shredded cabbage, and a red chili garnish.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
